description: This file defines the interface for the Device.IP.Diagnostics.TraceRoute object API in a TR-069 device management context. It includes function declarations for getting and setting IP diagnostics trace route parameters, such as DiagnosticsState, Interface, Host, NumberOfTries, Timeout, DataBlockSize, DSCP, MaxHopCount, ResponseTime, and RouteHopsNumberOfEntries. The file serves as a header for implementing trace route diagnostics functionalities in a device.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the IP diagnostics trace route diagnostics, such as 'Requested' or 'Complete'.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Interface
methods.description: Gets the IP interface used for the trace route test, typically a path like 'Device.IP.Interface.1'.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Host
methods.description: Fetches the hostname or IP address of the target host for tracing.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_NumberOfTries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of tries per hop in the trace route test.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Timeout
methods.description: Gets the timeout value in milliseconds for each hop in the trace route.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DataBlockSize
methods.description: Obtains the size of the data block sent in each trace route packet.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DSCP
methods.description: Fetches the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) used for test packets.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_MaxHopCount
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of hops (TTL) in outgoing probe packets.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_ResponseTime
methods.description: Gets the response time in milliseconds of the most recent trace route.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHopsNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the route hops table.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the diagnostics state, initiating or controlling trace route diagnostics.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Interface
methods.description: Sets the IP interface for the trace route test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Host
methods.description: Sets the target host for trace route.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_NumberOfTries
methods.description: Configures number of tries per hop for the test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Timeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout in milliseconds for each hop.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DataBlockSize
methods.description: Configures the size in bytes of the data block.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DSCP
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for test packets.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_MaxHopCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum hop count (TTL) for probe packets.
